If you have a [product_name] with display and are in admin mode, you can perform a factory reset. If you are in operator mode and do not know the password to switch to admin mode, there is no option for recovery.

Hello, I forgot my password for [product_name]. When I try to connect, it asks for a password and displays a message (attached). My device is [article_no], running [product_name] software [version_no]. I am in operator mode and do not know the admin password.

Without the password for [product_name] software access, you cannot perform a factory reset programmatically. If you are in operator mode and do not have the password to switch to admin mode, you cannot put the [product_name] into Stop mode via the display, which is required for a factory reset. As mentioned before, recovery is not possible in this scenario. If you are unsure, consider starting a support request.
Check out this related topic: [article_no] [product_name] - forgotten password.

analysis.insight_summary: Users who forget their password for [product_name] in operator mode face difficulty regaining access or performing a factory reset without the admin password. The recovery process lacks options for operator-mode scenarios, leading to potential loss of existing programs and user hesitation due to the risk of data loss. The limited recovery or support avenues contribute to frustration and operational delays.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a way to recover or reset the password without losing configuration or program data, and are seeking official support or alternative recovery solutions to gain access without erasing important information.
